summary: Council of Europe Development Bank filed a 424B5 pricing supplement for a $1 billion 4.000% Social Inclusion Bond due May 21, 2029. The offering is an ordinary debt issuance under an existing shelf registration, with proceeds of $997.74 million to the issuer after underwriting discounts. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or activist campaign is involved. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction by a supranational issuer.
